source.title: 2004 Trek Specifications Manual - U.S.
source.transcription: PyMuPDF text layer of the manufacturer PDF (not OCR); values copied verbatim.

equinox_9.color: Pearl White/Baja Blue • Silver/Black/Silver decal • Carbon weave fork
equinox_9.headset: Cane Creek BL, 22.2/30.2/26.4, 30.1 mm stack height
equinox_9.handlebar: Bontrager Race, bullhorn w/Profile Aerolite clipons, 26.0 mm clamp diameter
equinox_9.stem: Bontrager Race, 40.0 mm steerer clamp height
equinox_9.front_derailleur: Shimano 105, Down pull, Braze-on type w/34.9mm clamp attachment
equinox_9.crankset: Shimano Ultegra 53/39, 130 mm bolt hole circle
equinox_9.bottom_bracket: Shimano 105, 68 x 109.5 (shell x axle, mm), Shimano splined axle
equinox_9.front_wheel: Bontrager Race Aero, 16°, 575mm E.R.D., 281 mm radial spokes, Velox 16mm rim strip
equinox_9.rear_wheel: Bontrager Race Aero, 16°, 575 mm E.R.D., 288/288 mm 1x rear spokes, Velox 16mm rim strip
equinox_9.spokes: DT New Aero, internal alloy nipples
equinox_9.front_tire: Bontrager Race X Lite, folding, 700 x 23c
equinox_9.rear_tire: Bontrager Race X Lite, folding, 700 x 23c
equinox_9.seatpost: Bontrager Race X Lite, 27.2 mm outer diameter
equinox_9.saddle: SSM  Azoto Triathlon, CrMo rails, leather cover
equinox_9.seatpost_binder: Alloy w/integral bolt, 35.0 mm inner diameter
equinox_9.additionals: 2 water bottle mounts, rack mounts, shim to adapt 1 1/8” stem to 1” steerer
equinox_9.cassette_cogs_basis: Gear chart on the same page lists rows 12,13,14,15,16,17,19,21,23 against 39/53.

equinox_7.color: Metallic Charcoal/Titanite Black • White/Black/Silver decal • Carbon weave fork
equinox_7.crankset: Bontrager Race 53/39, 130 mm bolt hole circle

discrepancies.used: 370 mm for 700c sizes; 345 mm is taken to be the 650c fork. Not independently confirmed.
discrepancies.why: Both pages describe the same Alpha SL frame; the two-value entry on the Equinox 9 page matches the 650c/700c wheel split.
